params.1273: Decorate your house to your heart's content.
params.1274: Talk to an estate agent to buy a house, if you have not already.
params.1275: Get a saw, and a hammer if you haven't got one, and add them to your tool belt.
params.1276: You will need to smith some nails and turn logs into planks at the saw mill.
params.1277: Enter your house portal in build mode.
params.1278: Click any white transparent spot to build a new piece of furniture.
